The Jharkhand Staff Selection Commission (JSSC) is a government organization responsible for conducting competitive examinations for various government jobs in the state of Jharkhand.

The JSSC aims to provide a fair and transparent recruitment process for government jobs in Jharkhand.

About the Programme

The Jharkhand JSSC Excise Constable Competitive Examination JECCE 2023 is a competitive examination conducted by the JSSC for the recruitment of Excise Constables in the state of Jharkhand.

The programme aims to provide an opportunity for eligible candidates to join the government sector and serve the state of Jharkhand.
